responsibility: This makefile fragment integrates the GNU D frontend into GCC’s top-level build. It defines how the gdc driver and the d21 frontend executable are built and linked, enumerates the D frontend and language-specific object files that make up the compiler, sets D-specific compile and link flags, installs compiler and manual/info/html artifacts, wires DejaGNU test targets, and supplies custom pattern rules for compiling the imported DMD frontend sources and root library modules.
